name: dropzone_skydive
provenance: Hand-written layout fixture for the DropZone skydiving brief (tests/fixtures/README.md). Tests Steps 4-7 only — it says nothing about what the schema-fill LLM produces.
notes: VerticalCorridor + exit platform: locomotion=fly, altitude-banded content, a Cessna the player exits, a landing pad on the ground. Explicit objective kinds (collectible/goal) and no tags, the mirror image of dropzone_arcade's tag-carried meaning. FLOOR MOVED 98->95 when the custom_script_body check landed: ParachuteSystem and AltimeterManager carry no body, so each is a component attached to a live object that does nothing. The build did not get worse — a real defect that nothing measured before is now counted. Re-lock upward once Step 3.5a (unity_micro_code.enrich_scripts) authors them. The fixture's own ColoradoFreefall scene_spec carried an explicit `"entities": []` — 'host nothing', not the intended 'host everything' a single-scene skydive level actually wants — which the new entity_scene_coverage check (added after Grandma's Antique Shop shipped 8 of 14 named entities to no scene at all) was the first thing to ever notice and flag (7/7 entities named by no scene_spec). Fixed the fixture by omitting `entities` (host-everything default) rather than adding this check to ungraded_ok.
